variables.P_C: normalized path-cost diagnostic; not yet measured power

equation_entries.mathematical_role: result-based resource-constrained persistence principle and diagnostic
equation_entries.standard_physics_counterpart: open-system work/heat/entropy accounting and dynamical selection after lane-specific mapping

observable_mapping.proxy: measured work, heat flux, entropy production, transition/failure rate, or persistence time
observable_mapping.reason: the normalized path-cost term has not yet been mapped to a dimensional physical observable

equation_entries.parameter_dimensions: normalized diagnostic coefficients; physical power/energy dimensions are open
assumptions: selection is emergent from interaction and resource-constrained dynamics
no intention, agency, or universal optimizer is introduced
C is not universal mass, energy, force, or potential energy
resource accounting is lane-specific and does not assert global-universe conservation
equation_entries.symmetry_and_conservation: local normalized ledger identity checked; physical work/heat/entropy accounting remains lane-specific
limiting_cases: J_in=J_out=P_C=0 gives constant normalized available resource
equal-endpoint paths can have different cumulative cost
failure to map P_C to a physical observable leaves this a constitutive comparator
equation_entries.proof_status: candidate principle; normalized path-cost and ledger checks pass locally; physical derivation and observable mapping open
equation_entries.claim_boundary: candidate emergent persistence/resource-allocation principle; not a universal potential-energy law or empirical proof
equation_entries.failure_mode: path cost is treated as measured power, C as mass, or emergent selection as intentional optimization without a physical lane
equation_entries.next_hardening_step: derive an explicit interaction/state-transition lane and map path cost to measured work, heat, entropy production, or failure rate
